lines.trans: Comrade commander, the building is completely surrounded.
Excellent. We go inside quickly.
Here in the corridor are small children!
Right, put the children into the bus immediately!
Take them to the water park.
Everything is on the FSB!
But they do not have swimsuits!
No big deal.
They will sit quietly on the shore.
Understood. I will put them into the bus.
And what should we do with this door?
Come on, hand me the sledgehammer!
We will open this entrance right now.
